title: Glass Production Planning Software | Workshop Management | Coglass
description: Manage your glass production queue from a visual board. Track every item from order to ready, flag rush jobs, print barcode labels and never miss a deadline.
lead: See every pane in the queue, flag the rush jobs and scan barcodes from cut to ready. And the lead, Georgian and diamond patterns drawn on survey print as a 1:1 template the factory lays the glass straight onto.
steps_h2: From order placed to glass ready — fully tracked
steps_sub: The production board keeps your workshop and your office in sync at all times.
inc_h2: Production tools built for glass workshops
inc_sub: Everything your workshop team needs to stay on top of the queue — without spreadsheets or whiteboards.
steps: When an order is placed, its glass lines appear on the production board under To Plan, with a needed-by date suggested from each product's lead time.
Drag cards across the board as work progresses: To Plan → Waiting Supplier → Glass In → In Production → Ready → Made.
Set a priority — Normal, High or Urgent — and mark rush lines on the order, so the urgent work stands out.

Generate barcode labels directly from the production board. Each label shows the order number, customer, pane description and dimensions. Stick them to the glass in the workshop — scan to confirm receipt or completion.
At the bench, the shop-floor iPad scans a pane's barcode to move it to its next step — and works with a keyboard-wedge yard scanner.
Once glass is made, it moves to Made and the order shows it as ready for fitting, delivery or collection.
included: Visual kanban board
Six status columns: To Plan, Waiting Supplier, Glass In, In Production, Ready, Made. Drag to update status instantly.
Priority levels
Normal, High and Urgent priority flags — colour coded so urgent jobs are impossible to miss.
Rush lines
Mark any order line as rush so it is easy to spot on the board.
Needed-by dates
Suggested from each product's lead time, and editable per line.
Shop-floor iPad app
Cut list by station, per-pane ticks, IGU sealing steps and collection sign-off — on an iPad at the bench.
Barcode label printing
Print labels for every glass item in your workshop — order number, description, dimensions and barcode all included.
Barcode scanning
Scan labels on mobile to confirm glass received, mark items as made, or update status from the shopfloor.
Board order or needed-by
Switch the board between your own order and needed-by date.
Keeps working offline
The shop-floor app keeps the board on the iPad and syncs changes when the workshop wifi comes back.
Search
Search the board by order, customer, supplier, location or product.
Works with your scanner
Barcode scan-to-advance works with the iPad camera or a keyboard-wedge yard scanner.
Linked to orders and suppliers
Every production card links directly to the full order and supplier order — one click to see what's been ordered and when delivery is expected.
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
